exposure: length of stay in the birth suite
length of stay in the hospital
cohort: The study included 450 birthing parents who had given birth less than two months prior and were referred for their newborn's vaccination.
finding: Childbirth experience, maternal self-efficacy, spouse's employment status, number of previous childbirth experiences, frequency of receiving antenatal care, length of stay in the birth suite, and length of stay in the hospital were identified as significant predictors of maternal performance, explaining 53.2% of its variance.
